name: E35
supersedes: 2026-09-30-e31-mb as the current performance reference; previous frozen records remain unchanged
reuse_policy: Owner-promoted E35 reference: E31-MB plus the E35 `hybrid` verify length, measured with upstream Rigmark and the reference flags in two complete suites of the promoted arm (P2 and P3 of the E35 A-P-P-A series, n = 2) on one load, with the same-load `ema` arm A1/A4 kept per metric. Compare future candidates on one load against a same-load arm of this default with the same flags.

system.quantisation: FP8 target model; group-128 INT8 storage with BF16 activations for the 34 fused KDA input projections and, since E21, the 34 KDA o_proj and the 11 MLA o_proj, fused QKV-A and Q-B projections; since E22b also 30 DFlash2 drafter linears (qkv, o, gate_up, down, grouped-convolution kernel projections), with the drafter context K/V projection kept in BF16; remaining modules retain their preceding precision.
system.serving_engine: SparkRing/SparkCache R10 with hybrid KDA, E03 mHC prefill sharding, replay views and effective draft-budget verification, plus E21 BF16-residue 8-bit weights, plus E22b 8-bit DFlash2 drafter weights; E27 native prefill cadence (--prefill-schedule-interval 8); E27c scheduler: short prefills admitted on deferred steps and the cadence kept while requests are queued; E28b: seven draft tokens for a single request and a 16 GiB KV pool; E29: no speculative step past a possible length finish, and a 4 ms idle-coalescing window.; E31: speculative-safe C4 tail ring (12 slots for seven drafts), head-gate switch off.

adaptive_k.boot_line: AdaptiveKScheduler active (... mode=batch-uniform ... respect_draft_budget=1) engine_k=7 async=True

system.hardware: 4 x ASUS Ascent GX10, each with one NVIDIA GB10 and 128 GB unified memory
system.topology: TP4 over a two-port ConnectX-7 switchless RoCE ring; four direct edges at 200 Gb/s with MTU 9000
system.kv_cache: fp8_e4m3 with a 15032385536-byte pool per rank; shared target/KDA pool and dense FP8 DFlash draft allocation

observed_kv_capacity.interpretation: Engine-reported aggregate capacity, not a guarantee of that many simultaneous full-context requests; five complete maximum-length contexts cannot be resident at once and queue.
observed_kv_capacity.verified_on: Every KV14 boot; the E31-MB identity pins the boot line, and check-f0 passed on the 2026-09-30 boot.

active_kda_quantization.small_m_path: native Marlin W8A16 with padding to N=6400
active_kda_quantization.large_m_path: dequantization of the same INT8 weights into shared BF16 scratch plus native torch.nn.functional.linear
active_kda_quantization.checkpoint_on_disk: unchanged; conversion is applied after loading

disk_capacity.note: Selected at boot for the whole E35 window; it acts only when the accounted store exceeds 200 GiB.

sparkcache.distribution: Connector and encoder are operator-supplied pinned payloads; hashes do not grant redistribution rights.

system.scheduler: max sequences 6; max batched tokens 8192; AdaptiveKScheduler batch-uniform capped by the producing SchedulerOutput draft budget; async effective without --async-scheduling; prefill schedule interval 8 with the E27c scheduler: while requests decode, prefills with at least 2,048 remaining tokens run on one engine step in eight, shorter ones (up to 2,048 tokens per step) run at once, and the cadence stays on while requests are queued. Seven draft tokens for one request and three for 2-6 (E28). E29 scheduler: a running request whose step in flight may reach max_tokens is not given another step until that output arrives (structured output excluded); engine core: arrivals at an idle engine are collected for 4 ms before the first schedule. Operational layer: a 6,912-token per-step scheduling cap (steps above 72 tokens run eagerly) and allocator trim before every eager prefill step. E35: on a decode step with one request, the scheduler copy schedules seven drafts while the policy is lag1 or hybrid, and the model runner verifies 3 or 7 of them.
system.moe_backend: Triton FP8 MoE with GB10 tuning table sha256:e2d2f68d34ba9d0011c0b2ef48170781b4c7e609885cd4fb16d23221e795968b
system.collectives: Patched NCCL v2.30.7-1 with switchless-ring topology and SIRCL single-rail sync-prefill transport; automatic rank-local IPv4 RoCEv2 GID selection

transport.site_peer_and_gid_files: Operator configuration; excluded from this portable record

system.measurement_client: An external macOS workstation over direct LAN HTTP to the rank-0 API.

payload_packaging.source_files_scope: Hashes of the measured runtime sources and configuration that are distributed in this repository. Operator-supplied SparkCache source files are listed separately below; their canonical paths are relative to the deployed tp4 directory.
payload_packaging.manifest_difference: The distributed manifest lists every retained connector; the default selects the protected RAM-budget connector.

measured_runtime_substitution.note: The suites ran the measured overlay (E31-MB plus e35-runner-k/delta.env): the policy was written at runtime into the rank-0 container's /tmp/glm53-e35-policy as `hybrid` without a trailing newline. The default mounts policy.flag (`hybrid` with a newline) read-only at the same path; the reader strips whitespace, so the behaviour is the same and only that file's hash differs.

gpu_worker_probe.sampling: CUDA and pinned-host allocator counters from a background thread; no CUDA synchronization; process-lifetime peaks are not reset

external_host_observer.note: A read-only guard streamed MemAvailable from every rank and would have stopped the suite below 0.75 GiB; it never triggered.

instrumentation.e35_counters: Rank 0 logged its E35 decision counters every 200 participating steps.
instrumentation.overhead: Not measured separately from the policy; arm A carried the same broadcast on its seven-draft steps.

mhc_prefill.reductions: per-call deferral; native TP PyNccl reduce-scatter/all-gather
mhc_prefill.gpu_checks: Unchanged mHC sources: 4 ranks x 22 checks passed during the original E03 qualification.

e21_bf16_residue.large_m_path: dequantization into one BF16 scratch per distinct shape plus a dense GEMM at or above 2048 rows
e21_bf16_residue.mla_note: The MLA projections are block FP8 in the checkpoint and are dequantized to BF16 on load by the vendor model code; the INT8 step is a second quantization.

e22b_drafter_w8a16.small_m_path: native Marlin W8A16 for every converted drafter linear (query rows only; no scratch)
e22b_drafter_w8a16.context_kv: kept BF16, exactly as the vendor loader builds it
e22b_drafter_w8a16.drafter_override: image file byte for byte plus one appended flag-gated load hook

e31_indexer.upstream_status: vLLM PR #58454 (merged 2026-09-25, 2617fe93) fixes the same defect in upstream's own kpool compressor; the SparkRing source of the R10 image (FujitsuPolycom/vllm codex/glm53-gb10-operator-r10 at 22ffe140) still has the four-slot tail.

e35_verify_length.summary: On a decode step with one request and seven scheduled drafts, rank 0 of the V2 model runner chooses to verify 3 or 7 drafts from the DFlash2 selector's per-position confidence and broadcasts the choice over the tensor-parallel CPU group; every rank runs a trimmed copy of the scheduler output and trimmed drafts count as rejected.

rule.calibration: weighted isotonic survival from thinking-off E33 captures

source.comparison_note: Upstream, unmodified Rigmark with the reference flags; the same source hash as E31, exported with git archive. Frozen records before E31 used a local fork and are not comparable.

rigmark.cache_salt_policy: None. A fresh comparison ID per suite puts a new nonce at the start of every prompt.

performance.aggregation: Two complete suites of the promoted arm P on one load; per_run holds both values and median is their median (the mean of two). dispersion is their range. same_load_reference is the mean of the same-load `ema` suites A1 and A4 with their drift; e31mb_reference gives the frozen E31-MB value for context only.

post_boot_gates.scope: The E35 load, booted on 2026-09-30 at 11:01 UTC and retained through the held-out screen and all four suites.

functional.process_continuity: Same four loaded serving processes through the whole E35 window; the policy changed at runtime.

memory.note: MemAvailable streamed from all ranks during both suites; the 0.75 GiB stop never triggered.

limits: Two suites of one arm on one load (n = 2); C1/C2/C4 end-to-end differences within about 7% are not distinguishable from noise.

Against the same-load `ema` arm, code decode (+0.1%) and C1 (+1.8%) are within that arm's drift (+0.9%, +1.9%); prose decode is -1.5%, judged noise by the owner; decode time to first token is about 30 ms lower in both suites.
The measured policy was written at runtime into the container; the default mounts an equivalent read-only file.
The E35 calibration came from thinking-off captures; the suites ran with reasoning effort low.
Upstream Rigmark with the reference flags; not comparable with the frozen E29-and-earlier records.
Generated-answer quality is not a performance gate; native output gates are recorded as measured.
